editorial.blurb: Nikko Sushi Izakaya delivers fresh, innovative sushi in a vibrant multi-level space where all-you-can-eat nigiri and creative rolls shine alongside their surprisingly beloved ube ice cream.
editorial.insiderTip: Go early on weekdays or make a reservation—this spot fills up fast, especially weekends. Order the nigiri and chef specials early in your AYCE meal to ensure you get the freshest cuts before the kitchen gets slammed.
